reasons.action: The brief asks the man at the counter to speak the recorded line again word for word, an explicit requested vocal performance, so the action is request-governed.
reasons.medium: No visual reference and no explicit rendering style; the only supplied asset is an audio voice-timbre reference, so no reference has authority over the rendering medium and it remains request-governed with no referenced family to follow.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference is present and no clothing is described in the brief, so wardrobe falls to the request by default with nothing observed to inherit.
reasons.lighting: The audio reference carries no illumination information and no visual reference exists, so no observed lighting applies and lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: The brief only places the man at the counter, which is not itself a camera composition; with no visual reference, framing is request-governed rather than reference-driven.
reasons.palette: The audio reference supplies only voice timbre and delivery, containing no color or tonal information, and with no visual reference the palette is request-governed.
